title: Case 032: Customer cannot print a return label

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The approved return offers a printer-free QR token at a specified staffed counter. The token is inert and usable only within the fictional exercise.
initial_request: I do not own a printer. Could you arrange the QR return option and tell me which counter accepts it?
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request an available printer-free return option from the merchant.

outcome: The customer receives a valid QR code and confirmed supported drop-off location.
boundaries: Token receipt is not drop-off or refund. QR payload is inert, not a live return authorisation.

events.body: RT-032 for TG-032, original shipment DL-032, is approved. Our return service supports printer-free QR presentation at Copperfin Returns Counter, 10:00–18:00 UTC. The token must be issued by returns; no customer printer is required.
I do not own a printer. Could you arrange the QR return option and tell me which counter accepts it?
Please issue the printer-free QR token for approved RT-032 and confirm a supported drop-off counter and its hours.

events.to: Oska Vey, customer; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Token DL032R is valid for RT-032 in our fictional returns system. [Open the QR return token](attachments/return-qr.png). Copperfin Returns Counter supports it, 10:00–18:00 UTC; staff print the service label after scanning the token. No payment or credential URL is encoded.
I have the QR image and can see its fallback token DL032R. I will take it to Copperfin Returns Counter during 10:00–18:00. I have not dropped off the parcel yet.
